title: BRINDRAVAN ENTERPRISES PVT LTD versus STATE INFRASTRUCTURE AND INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT

paras.text:
UKHC010211412025
2026:UHC:9928
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
AT NAINITAL
HON'BLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE MR. MANOJ KUMAR TIWARI
ARBITRATION APPLICATION NO. 77 OF 2025
30TH OCTOBER, 2026
Brindravan Enterprises Pvt. Ltd. ...... Applicant/Petitioner
Versus
State Infrastructure & Industrial Development
Corporation of Uttarakhand Limited ...... Respondent
Counsel for the applicant : Mr. Neeraj Garg, learned Senior
Counsel assisted by Mr. Yashpal
Singh, learned counsel
Counsel for the respondent : Mr. Vipul Sharma, learned counsel

The Court made the following:
JUDGMENT:
1) This is an application under Section 11(5) of the
Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 for appointment of a
Sole Arbitrator.
2) It is not in dispute that a lease-deed qua
1,03,249 sq.mt. land was executed by SIIDCUL in favour
of the applicant on 25.01.2023 for the purpose of
developing a tourist village at Village Madan Negi, District
Tehri Garhwal. The said lease-deed was, however,
1

UKHC010211412025
2026:UHC:9928
terminated by SIIDCUL on 24.09.2025. The lease-deed
contains arbitration agreement in clauses 9.2, 9.3 and
9.4, which are reproduced below :
 "9.2. All disputes and differences in relation to the
applicability, interpretation, rights and obligations of
the parties hereunder and/or arising under these
presents, shall be referred to a Sole Arbitrator, to be
nominated by the Managing Director of the Lessor
within thirty (30) days from the date of receipt of a
request for nomination of Sole Arbitrator, the Managing
Director of the Lessor shall, nominate the Sole
Arbitrator and issue communication in respect of the
same to the parties. In case, the Sole Arbitrator is not
nominated within the period stipulated hereinabove,
the parties will be at liberty to invoke the provision of
the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 and any
subsequent amendments thereto or enactment(s) in
substitution thereof, for appointment of Arbitrator.
9.3. The arbitral proceedings shall be governed by
the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 and any
subsequent amendments thereto of enactments in
substitution thereof.
9.4. The arbitral proceedings shall be conducted in
Dehradun, in English language and the parties agree
that the arbitral award shall be binding and enforceable
against the parties."
3) Applicant gave notice to SIIDCUL invoking
arbitration agreement on 19.11.2025. Since reply to the
notice was not received by the applicant, therefore, it filed
2

UKHC010211412025
2026:UHC:9928
present application under Section 11(5) of the Act for
appointment of a sole Arbitrator.
4) Mr. Neeraj Garg, learned Senior Counsel
points out that reply to the notice given by the
applicant was received by the applicant after filing of
present arbitration application.
5) Mr. Vipul Sharma, learned counsel appearing
for the SIIDCUL submits that since there is an
arbitration agreement in the lease-deed, therefore, the
dispute can be referred for arbitration and, he has no
objection if an arbitrator is appointed.
6) Learned counsel for the parties unanimously
suggested that Mr. Justice J.C.S. Rawat, Retired Judge
of Uttarakhand High Court and Jharkhand High Court
can be appointed as the sole Arbitrator to decide the
dispute between the parties.
7) In that view of the matter, I appoint Mr.
Justice J.C.S. Rawat, Retired Judge of this Court, R/o
Lane No. 8-A, Ekta Vihar, Dehradun to act as a sole
Arbitrator to arbitrate the disputes that have arisen
between the parties. The seat of arbitration shall be at
Dehradun.
3

UKHC010211412025
2026:UHC:9928
8) The arbitration application stands allowed in
the above terms.
9) The Arbitrator shall, in terms of Section 11(8)
of the Act, furnish his disclosure in writing to the Court
within 15 days from the date of receipt of a certified
copy of this order.
10) It is open for the parties to determine the rules
and procedure of arbitration in consultation with the
Arbitrator in terms of Sections 19 of the Act. The
Arbitrator shall, in consultation with the parties, fix the
remuneration and other chargeable fees. The Arbitrator
shall endeavour to hear and pass an Award within the
time provided under the statute.

_________________________ MANOJ KUMAR TIWARI, A.C.J.
Dt: 30TH OCTOBER, 2026
Negi
